prompt: Production stylized fantasy game SPRITE SHEET from the attached approved design, glossy sculpted 3D-to-2D rendering, high quality small-game readability. EXACTLY EIGHT walking animation frames in a strict FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, reading left to right across top then bottom. Wide 2:1 canvas if possible, equal cells with margins. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA, no background, no ground, no shadows, no aura, no labels or text. All frames SAME full-body character, body scale, camera and top-left light. Orthographic slightly overhead frontal camera, facing downward straight toward viewer, no diagonal rotation. Body center stays at horizontal center of its cell, ground projection stays at 87.5% cell height, no sliding left-right. Equipment stays in the same anatomical hand. Low-step alternating walk (not marching): frame1 LEFT boot reaches front and right trails; 2 left supports, right foot lifts; 3 RIGHT foot passes under body; 4 right reaches forward; 5 RIGHT boot contacts front and left trails; 6 right supports and left lifts; 7 LEFT passes under body; 8 left extends forward to close cycle. Front-facing left/right legs must visibly ALTERNATE over the eight poses. Bent relaxed knees, clear contacting foot, modest hip bob only, no duplicate poses, both feet always visible. Preserve all headgear, weapons and body features. Render second boss in bottom row only: imposing dark green orc warlord, black iron armor trimmed with brass, broad angular shoulder plates, red cloak, heavy boots, large broad axe in RIGHT hand (viewer left). Gritty sculpted surfaces but clean mobile silhouette, stern face with tusks, heavy controlled alternating steps.
